purpose: Qualify a coherent, separately versioned price basis before any further portfolio search. Data-source selection must not use model or portfolio performance.
candidate_source: One bounded, paginated Futu QFQ/RTH intake for SOXL and SOXX, with an unchanged before/after rehabilitation event table and original page payloads. Fresh quote vintage is preferred to appending current-adjustment bars into the mixed-vintage archive.
qualification: Qlib-managed reference calendar and instrument-session grain; unique dates and exact coverage disclosed
All finite positive OHLC; low<=open,close<=high; no synthesized highs/lows or per-field stitching
Recorded volume source and units; no silent zero fills
No returned market dates beyond the requested as_of; original request and observation timestamps retained
All SDK pages, parameters, original responses and hashes retained; retrieval failures never masquerade as empty valid data
Compare fresh/archived overlaps and rehabilitation metadata before applying any source-level conversion
Retain and diagnose any missing sessions; do not silently remove model training rows
A secondary source may supply only a coherent full bar with explicit source identity and independently justified common adjustment; never choose fields or adjustments by portfolio results
Corporate-action transformations must be identical across each bar OHLC, preserve physical ordering and record the convention; no return-fitted arbitrary scaling
Build a NEW Qlib provider only after required source and coverage gates; native D.calendar/D.instruments/D.features readback must match its manifest
Old providers, model evidence, live SIM/paper code, and unrelated main-worktree data remain untouched
known_evidence: Bounded Futu probes recovered the eight2026 dates. Seven disputed historical opens are corroborated by retained Futu against the execution channel; a uniform adjustment of primary Yahoo bars is therefore not automatically a qualified replacement.
scope_limits: This data work cannot establish stable excess returns.
Unavailable inception/warm-up data must be distinguished from missing2011+training sessions; any coverage decision must be explicit before model fitting.
Previously inspected market history remains reused evidence, even after a better source version is frozen.
next_model_test: After data qualification, preregister the conditional daily-variance comparison on a common annual budget, with expanding/open20/close20/OOFvol5 controls and unchanged H5 mean/cost/economic gates. The proposal is not authorized to select a source using returns.

data_design_amendment.reason: Fresh full Futu QFQ and NONE both lack16SOXL sessions. Published rehabilitation A/B does not exactly reconstruct server QFQ (measured maximum ~1.44bp on control quotes), so an approximate16row splice into SDKQFQ would mix conventions.
data_design_amendment.basis_scope: Apply the same explicitly published affine convention to EVERY row, not just secondary-source rows. This is a separately defined research price basis, not claimed to reproduce serverQFQ exactly.
data_design_amendment.primary_source: Fresh bounded Futu NONE/RTH all available full OHLCV bars, unchanged rehab content before/after intake.
data_design_amendment.secondary_source: Only genuine full Yahoo chart bars for16missingSOXL dates; no replacement of available Futu bars. Original split-adjusted OHLCV retained; exact future split ratios reconstruct unadjusted input units before the common affine transform.
data_design_amendment.price_transform: For events strictly after each session and no later thanas_of, compose published A/B chronologically: A_total=A_total*A_event;B_total=B_total*A_event+B_event. Apply raw_price*A_total+B_total identically toOHLC. No fitted coefficients or clipped bars.
data_design_amendment.volume_transform: Exact share ratios from split/join numerator/denominator, not rounded price factors; final volume_basis=split_adjusted_shares.
data_design_amendment.known_quote_uncertainty: NeighboringJan2012Yahoo/Futu open quotations disagree beyond floating precision. This is retained source uncertainty, not a split factor to fit away. Secondary bars are labeled Yahoo, never Futu or exchange ground truth.
data_design_amendment.qualification_scope: Coverage, physical consistency, source evidence and correct declared transformations; does not guarantee historical market-price truth. If a financial candidate passes later, source sensitivity must be reported before deployment claims.
data_design_amendment.future_adjustment_scope: One nonzeroB event occurs2010-09-22;none after2010 or model start2011. Preserve the affine effect in warmup history. Future multiplicative adjustments cancel in model-period price ratios; downstream feature transform invariance must still be checked.
